messages.en:
{07 16 00}Oh, you should have stopped
by sooner, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!

As you can see, I've caught
{04 1a 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
Some time ago, in fact.
{07 14 00}You, my friend, are slow,{01 00 00 05 00}
and I am the winner! Yup!
I beat you, {04 1f 00}!
{07 0a 00}I'm so happy! I rocked your
world, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! I reign
supreme, the insect queen!
{07 14 00}It's not just about
reflexes or bug knowledge...{01 00 00 05 00}

It's about DEDICATION,
my friend.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Oh, sa oleksid pidanud
varem tulema, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!

Nagu näed, olen ma püüdnud
{04 1a 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
Tegelikult juba ammu.
{07 14 00}Sina, sõber, oled aeglane,{01 00 00 05 00}
ja mina olen võitja! Jah!
Ma võitsin sind, {04 1f 00}!
{07 0a 00}Ma olen nii õnnelik! Ma
raputasin sind, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Olen putukate kuninganna!
{07 14 00}Asi pole ainult
refleksides ega tarkuses...{01 00 00 05 00}

Asi on PÜHENDUMUSES,
mu sõber.

messages.en:
{07 0a 00}Oh, too bad, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{04 1a 00}

between {04 01 00} and
{04 00 00}, {07 0a 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I win! Yeah!
{07 14 00}But don't get too down
